originalTitle: Wisconsin result dents winning streak for Democratic Party's left wing
summary: Centrist David Crowley is projected to have beaten democratic socialist Francesca Hong, breaking a recent nationwide trend.
content:
David Crowley was considered the centrist candidate in the contest to select the Democrats' candidate for Wisconsin governor

David Crowley is projected to have won a primary election to become the Democratic candidate for Wisconsin governor, in a surprise comeback victory that dents a winning streak for the party's left wing.

Crowley, the more centrist candidate, won a narrow victory over Francesca Hong, according to a projection by the BBC's partner, CBS News.

Anti-establishment Democrats across the US had previously notched up victories that have rattled the party leadership in Washington. That trend did continue in another closely-watched Democratic contest in Minnesota.

But in Wisconsin, the governor's race in November will be contested by Crowley and Tom Tiffany, who easily won the equivalent Republican contest.

Crowley, the chief executive officer of the state's Milwaukee County, had a lead of less than half a percentage point over Hong with almost all votes in the Democratic contest counted, according to CBS.

In the early hours of Wednesday, he posted on X to say it was time to "get to work".

Crowley reiterated that his missions were "making life more affordable, strengthening our schools, creating good-paying jobs, and making sure opportunity reaches every corner of our state".

His new opponent Tiffany, meanwhile, currently serves as a US congressman and has the backing of US President Donald Trump.

Tiffany has also highlighted affordability issues, running on a platform that includes lowering taxes, supporting farmers and improving healthcare.

The state's political matchups are expected to be closely fought during November's midterm elections, which have also wider implications for the control of the US Congress.

Left-wing Democrats are on a winning run - but can they lure back crucial swing voters?

The Hong-Crowley contest for the Democrats was just one of several closely-watched races that were held on Tuesday, and there was good news elsewhere for those on the party's left wing.

In neighbouring Minnesota, candidate Peggy Flanagan secured the Democratic nomination for the upcoming US Senate race, defeating her more centrist opponent Angie Craig.

Meanwhile in Connecticut, there was a continuation of a different trend that has been witnessed in Democratic primaries across the country - with a challenger candidate unseating a long-term incumbent. Luke Bronin defeated John Larson, who has served 14 terms, to become the candidate for a House seat.

And in South Carolina, Darline Graham Nordone advanced to a run-off vote later this month in a special Republican primary for the US Senate which was held following the death of her brother, Senator Lindsey Graham. She will face off against Democrat Annie Andrews to fill the vacant seat.

Crowley's comeback in Wisconsin was all the more unexpected to many observers, given that he briefly dropped his bid last month in order to support a rival, and at one point trailed Hong by a double-digit margin in pre-election polling.

But he enjoyed a late surge having re-entered the race with the backing of Tony Evers, the state's current governor.

Hong, a Wisconsin state assemblywoman, a single mother and a former chef, was believed by many observers to be the frontrunner as she entered election day in what proved to be a crowded Democratic primary.

She aimed to become the first democratic socialist to govern the state. However, some of her historical comments raised questions about whether she could have beaten her Republican opponent.

Hong faced particular scrutiny for remarks about police funding and the US Thanksgiving holiday - some of which she later walked back.

Prominent left-wing politicians Vermont Senator Bernie Sanders and New York Congresswoman Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez, who both often endorse insurgent candidates such as Hong, notably stayed out of this race.

AP News reported that Hong had conceded the race to Crowley, and that her campaign manager had said Hong was "proud of the race we ran".

Some of Francesca Hong's historical comments had raised questions about whether she could defeat a Republican rival

Hong's defeat brings to an end a series of wins for left-wing candidates in Democratic primaries.

Some of the successful candidates been endorsed by, or affiliated with, the Democratic Socialists of America (DSA) organisation.

They have gained traction with voters not just by running against Republican policies, but by challenging the Democratic status quo in Washington set by the party's current leaders.

They have also found traction by demanding the US end or curtail funding to Israel, due to its ongoing military operation in Gaza.

Last week, for example, Abdul El-Sayed won the Democratic primary for Michigan's US Senate seat, beating Congresswoman Haley Stevens.

And in June, New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani endorsed a trio of progressive Democrats in the regions' US House races, all of whom won their primaries.

Mamdani's picks unseated two sitting lawmakers and beating the hand-picked successor of a retiring congresswoman.

Additional reporting by Kayla Epstein and Sareen Habeshian

chineseTitle: 威斯康星州的结果削弱了民主党左翼的连胜纪录
chineseSummary: 预计中间派大卫·克劳利将击败民主社会主义者弗朗西斯卡·洪，打破最近的全国趋势。
chineseContent:
大卫·克劳利被认为是威斯康星州州长民主党候选人竞选中的中间派候选人

大卫·克劳利预计将赢得初选，成为威斯康星州州长的民主党候选人，他出人意料地卷土重来，削弱了该党左翼的连胜纪录。

根据英国广播公司合作伙伴哥伦比亚广播公司新闻的预测，较为中间派的候选人克劳利以微弱优势击败了弗朗西斯卡·洪。

美国各地的反建制民主党此前取得的胜利让华盛顿的民主党领导层感到不安。在明尼苏达州另一场备受关注的民主党竞选中，这种趋势确实延续了。

但在威斯康星州，11 月份的州长竞选将由克劳利和汤姆·蒂芙尼角逐，后者轻松赢得了同等的共和党竞选。

据哥伦比亚广播公司报道，在民主党竞选中几乎所有选票都已清点的情况下，该州密尔沃基县的首席执行官克劳利领先洪不到半个百分点。

周三凌晨，他在 X 上发帖称是时候“开始工作”了。

克劳利重申，他的使命是“让生活变得更便宜，加强我们的学校，创造高薪就业机会，并确保机会到达我们州的每个角落”。

与此同时，他的新对手蒂芙尼目前担任美国国会议员，并得到了美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的支持。

蒂芙尼还强调了负担能力问题，其运营平台包括降低税收、支持农民和改善医疗保健。

预计该州的政治角力将在 11 月中期选举期间展开激烈角逐，这也对美国国会的控制产生更广泛的影响。

左翼民主党正在取得胜利，但他们能吸引关键的摇摆选民回来吗？

民主党的洪-克劳利竞选只是周二举行的几场备受关注的竞选之一，对于党内左翼人士来说，其他地方也有好消息。

在邻近的明尼苏达州，候选人佩吉·弗拉纳根 (Peggy Flanagan) 击败了更为中间派的对手安吉·克雷格 (Angie Craig)，获得了即将举行的美国参议院竞选的民主党提名。

与此同时，在康涅狄格州，全国民主党初选中出现了一种不同的趋势——挑战者候选人取代了长期现任者。卢克·布罗宁 (Luke Bronin) 击败连任 14 届的约翰·拉尔森 (John Larson)，成为众议院席位的候选人。

在南卡罗来纳州，达琳·格雷厄姆·诺多内 (Darline Graham Nordone) 于本月晚些时候在美国参议院共和党特别初选中进入决选，该初选是在她的兄弟、参议员林赛·格雷厄姆 (Lindsey Graham) 去世后举行的。她将与民主党人安妮·安德鲁斯对决，以填补空缺席位。

克劳利在威斯康星州的复出对许多观察家来说更加出乎意料，因为他上个月为了支持竞争对手而短暂放弃了竞选，并且在选前民意调查中一度以两位数的优势落后于洪。

但在该州现任州长托尼·埃弗斯(Tony Evers)的支持下，他重新参加竞选后，他的支持率在后期飙升。

洪是威斯康星州女议员、单身母亲和前厨师，许多观察人士认为，她在选举日当天的民主党初选中是领先者，事实证明她是拥挤的民主党初选。

她的目标是成为第一位治理国家的民主社会主义者。然而，她的一些历史评论引发了人们对她是否能够击败共和党对手的质疑。

洪因有关警察经费和美国感恩节假期的言论而受到特别关注，其中一些言论后来她又收回了。

著名的左翼政治家佛蒙特州参议员伯尼·桑德斯和纽约州国会女议员亚历山大·奥卡西奥-科尔特斯都经常支持像洪这样的叛乱候选人，但他们显然没有参与这场竞选。

据美联社新闻报道，洪在比赛中输给了克劳利，她的竞选经理表示洪“为我们参加的比赛感到自豪”。

弗朗西斯卡·洪（Francesca Hong）的一些历史评论引发了人们对她是否能够击败共和党对手的质疑

洪的失败结束了左翼候选人在民主党初选中的一系列胜利。

一些成功的候选人得到了美国民主社会主义者 (DSA) 组织的认可或附属。

他们不仅通过反对共和党的政策，而且通过挑战该党现任领导人在华盛顿设定的民主党现状，赢得了选民的支持。

由于以色列在加沙的军事行动正在进行，他们还要求美国停止或削减对以色列的资助，从而获得了支持。

例如，上周，阿卜杜勒·赛义德 (Abdul El-Sayed) 击败国会女议员海莉·史蒂文斯 (Haley Stevens)，赢得了密歇根州美国参议院席位的民主党初选。

6 月，纽约市市长佐兰·马姆达尼 (Zohran Mamdani) 在该地区的美国众议院竞选中支持了三位进步民主党人，他们都赢得了初选。

马姆达尼的选择推翻了两名现任议员，并击败了一位退休国会女议员精心挑选的继任者。

Kayla Epstein 和 Sareen Habeshian 的补充报道
